<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges (including aromatic) with retrieve_carbon_shifts. By comparing the observed shifts to the aromatic range (approximately 110–160 ppm), I can count how many signals correspond to aromatic carbons and provide that integer as the answer.</thought>
